test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The cost of painting a cube on all the external surfaces at the rate of ₹2/cm ² is ₹588. Find the volume of the cube (in cm³).
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of painting at a rate of Rs. 2/cm² = Rs. 588

**Formula used:**

The surface area of the cube = 6a²

The volume of the cube = (a)³

Where 'a' is the side of the cube.

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Cost of paintings = 2 × Surface area of a cube

588 = 2 × 6a²

⇒ 12a² = 588

⇒ a² = 588/12

⇒ a = √49 = 7 cm

Now the volume of Cube

Volume = (7)³ = 343 cm³

**∴ The volume of the cube is 343 cm3**.
